idea-plugin.name: FSL — Fluxxi Shader Language
idea-plugin.description:
Syntax highlighting for the Fluxxi Shader Language (.fsl), a compute-shader language that transpiles to GLSL.

Highlights kernel[x, y, z] declarations, layout(...) buffer/texture resources, FSL vector type aliases (float2, int4, ...), parameter specifiers, name bindings such as id : GlobalInvocationID, preprocessor directives, and GLSL builtins.
